mission.Pirates_Corp_RaiderCapture1.deta:
Details: Corporations are not only a source of loot for pirates, but also eternal enemies. The chaos that has arisen in the Solar System can be used to show corporations that they are not the only masters here.

Apparently, %VICTIM_NAME% has weakened its control over %STATION_NAME%. The pirates are ready to take control of the station. However, here and now they do not have the strength for a direct, organized attack. Do you have something personal for %VICTIM_NAME%, Boss? The pirates will not remain in debt.

So, we need to eliminate everyone who is able to hold a weapon and evacuate before this place becomes another branch of hell. The pirate crew, under whose control %STATION_NAME% will be transferred, will appear when we leave the facility.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Robbery1.after: %VICTIM_NAME% will have to deal with the mess we created at %STATION_NAME% for a long time. The pirates took the junk and handed over some of their toys. Do you have a feeling that this was not just a robbery? We were used, <color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>?
mission.Pirates_Corp_Robbery1.briefing: Welcome to the world of pirates! Walk through each floor of the station, collect the marked items and escape with the loot.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Robbery1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>, the pirate crew has contacted us. Offers to take part in a vulgar robbery. They want valuables that %VICTIM_NAME% holds at %STATION_NAME%, but they cannot afford a direct attack right now. But we can. If we agree, we will need to <color=#FFFEC1>find the specified objects</color> on each floor of the station and evacuate with them.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Robbery1.objective0: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> On each floor of %STATION_NAME%, pick up valuable items, then evacuate.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Sabotage1.after: %STATION_NAME% has been excluded from %VICTIM_NAME% structure for some time. The pirates transferred valuable cargo to Magnum.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Sabotage1.briefing: The locations of the communication nodes have been marked on your map. Do not be surprised that they are so far from you — we had to maneuver. The security of %STATION_NAME% has already been placed on alert. Nothing unusual: the local Security Service. Possibly a <color=#FFFEC1>PMC</color>. Let me remind you that the task is not to collect everything valuable in this place. The <color=#FFFEC1>task is to destroy the transmitters</color>.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Sabotage1.details:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% has firmly integrated %STATION_NAME% into its structure. Thanks to this asset, they managed to gain a strong foothold in the planetary market. Pirates have been eyeing this station for a long time: it would be an excellent base for organizing daring attacks in this part of the System.

There is a reliable way to prepare the space station for an invasion. If we strike at the communication system of %STATION_NAME%, which ensures its operation with the rest of the structural elements of %VICTIM_NAME%, then the owner will be forced to loosen its grip.

If we strike precisely the Unchained Belt will thank us generously.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Sabotage1.objective: You need to <color=#FFFEC1>find and destroy the transmitters</color>. A transmitter is a satellite dish aimed into space. A marker is present on your map.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Control1.after: The pirates realized that %VICTIM_NAME% was not all-powerful. Sooner or later, pirates will begin their raids on quasimorphic objects.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Control1.briefing: The server location is marked on your map. The quasimorphs are already at %STATION_NAME%. Eliminate them all. The <color=#FFFEC1>equipment must survive</color>.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Control1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> Pirates have seriously gained a foothold at %STATION_NAME%. From here they carried out several successful operations against %VICTIM_NAME%. However, the monsters gathered for a counterattack. Their target will be the station's server equipment. If we want to receive a reward from the pirates, we need to <color=#FFFEC1>prevent the quasimorphs from destroying the computer</color>.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Counterattack1.aft: The pirates have already transferred the reward to Magnum. I like these guys: for them both quasimorphs and corporations are a source of loot.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Counterattack1.bri: It won't be possible to drop you off any closer. A real war has been going on at %STATION_NAME% for several days. We'll have to hurry. <color=#FFFEC1>Stop the quasimorphs before the ritual ends</color>.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Counterattack1.des: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate the group of quasimorphs from %VICTIM_NAME% before the <color=#FFFEC1>ritual</color> is completed.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Counterattack1.det: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> Lately, surges in quasimorphosis have been felt at %STATION_NAME%. The captain of the pirate crew told us about this. He asks for help. Apparently, this bramfatura activity attracted %VICTIM_NAME%. They have captured part of the station and are preparing to hold some kind of <color=#FFFEC1>ritual</color> there. You need to get to them and eliminate them before they complete the ritual. The pirates promise a worthy reward for your help.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Counterattack1.obj: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate the group of quasimorphs from %VICTIM_NAME% before the <color=#FFFEC1>ritual</color> is completed.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Defense1.after: The reward from the pirates is already on Magnum. %STATION_NAME% will serve the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> for some time to come. But people, whatever they may be, are still better than quasimorphs. Right?
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Defense1.briefing: As soon as we get you there, the attack will begin. Sensors show that quasimorphs have already appeared in certain places of %STATION_NAME%. <color=#FFFEC1>Hold out</color> for a while, and their onslaught will weaken. It seems that they are not omnipotent either.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Defense1.details:
Details: Due to the public enemy status, the pirates cannot directly report that %STATION_NAME% is about to be attacked by %VICTIM_NAME%.

Our analysts discovered this information with the help of the quasimorphs themselves. They have learned to bypass the SBN filters and constantly transmit messages to the network. The Hexarchy immediately declares them fakes.

If we want to support the beleaguered pirate crew, then we should hurry.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Elimination1.after: The pirates asked us for quite a long time about the structure of %STATION_NAME% and what we discovered there. Obviously, they can decide to capture it at any moment. The reward is already in the Magnum's cargo hold.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Elimination1.brief: We observe unimaginable leaps of quasimorphosis. We'll drop you off wherever we can. Your task: <color=#FFFEC1>kill the Duke</color>. Don’t try to be a hero and clear out the entire %STATION_NAME%, we have a clear task with clear conditions.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Elimination1.detai:
Details: The Unchained Belt has had its eye on %STATION_NAME% for a long time. The pirates would like to make it their base in this part of the Solar System. The station is now in the hands of %VICTIM_NAME%. If they manage to capture it, the corporatists will not even notice that %STATION_NAME% is now in the hands of the pirate crew.

Only the pirates found out that the station is home to a quasimorph of the Duke class and began searching for a contractor to eliminate this monster. This is where we come into play.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Escort1.after: The pirates sent us a valuable package as a reward for saving their man. The cargo is already on board Magnum.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Escort1.briefing: <color=#FFFEC1>Escort</color> the captain to the specified location at %STATION_NAME%. Move from level to level until you are safe. Exploring %STATION_NAME% is not included in the task list, but if you see something interesting, act according to the circumstances.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Escort1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the pirate captain to the safe location.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Escort1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> At %STATION_NAME% one of the headquarters of the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> is located. The pirate captain in command here has carried out several successful operations against the quasimorphs. And now %VICTIM_NAME% is going to attack the station. If we take on this urgent contract, we will need to <color=#FFFEC1>escort</color> the captain to the safe location.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Escort1.objective0: Another day, another mission against the quasimorphs. <color=#FFFEC1>Your task</color>: escort the pirate captain to safety.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Espionage1.after: The meeting with the pirate crew took place. They almost tried to bite this quasimorphic rock. Valuable cargo from them is on Magnum.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Espionage1.briefin:
The signature of the igvalite has been found, its location is marked on the map. We'll try to drop you off as close to the location as possible, but we can't promise anything: the shuttle pilot is already reporting strange visions.

Move through %STATION_NAME% carefully, save your strength. %VICTIM_NAME% will certainly defend the igvalite with special zeal.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Espionage1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color> at %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Espionage1.details:
Details: The Unchained Belt is planning operations related to %STATION_NAME%. Despite the suppression of information by the Hexarchy, it is known that this place is in the hands of %VICTIM_NAME%. The pirates discovered something interesting there.

They caught the signature of an igvalite - a quasimorphic artifact capable of accumulating gavvakh. It appears that the quasimorphs use this location to store energy. There is work for us. The pirate liaison offers to infiltrate %STATION_NAME% and pick up the igvalite.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Espionage1.objecti: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color> at %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_RaiderCapture1.aft: A pirate crew arrived at %STATION_NAME%, to which the council of commanders of the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> transferred control. Looks like the pirates are here to stay. We got what we were due: the cargo is already on Magnum.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_RaiderCapture1.bri:
We don't know why exactly these quasimorphs remain in our reality. As a rule, the quasimorphosis subsides soon after the violence stops. But %VICTIM_NAME% has learned to overcome this limitation. You'll have to work manually.

After disembarking, methodically move forward through %STATION_NAME% and shoot everything that moves. Keep your eyes open and try to be prepared for any turn of events. Good luck.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_RaiderCapture1.det:
Details: After %VICTIM_NAME% appeared in the Solar System, the space pirates did not think long. If something can become prey for the Unchained Belt, it will become it. The pirates want to recruit us to capture %STATION_NAME% in order to use it as a base of operations in this part of the Solar System.

Here's what we need to do: walk through %STATION_NAME% and destroy it as as many quasimorphs as possible. These creatures act on behalf of %VICTIM_NAME% and it is unknown how they learned to linger in physical reality for a long time.
mission.Pirates_Shedu_Robbery1.after: The pirates realized that even quasimorphs could be defeated. They gave us some of their toys. Do you feel like we were being used in the dark, <color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>?

If we agree, we will need to <color=#FFFEC1>find the specified objects</color> on each floor of the station and evacuate with them. After this, %VICTIM_NAME% will remember us for a long time. They always remember.
